areas.name: Zona Rosa
areas.summary: Geschäfts- und Unterhaltungsviertel mit vielen Hotels, Clubs, Restaurants und einer großen schwulen Szene.

nightlife.why: Rund um die Uhr Betrieb, viele Bars und Clubs – „Zona Rosa is probably the only area in Mexico City that really never sleeps.“

quiet.why: Durchgehend belebt, wenig Ruhe – „Zona Rosa is probably the only area in Mexico City that really never sleeps.“

food.why: Viele Restaurants an der Calle Genova – „The area has a few pedestrian-only streets, being Genova the main street where many restaurants and shops are located.“

safety.why: Viel Aufdringlichkeit durch Verkäufer, aber kein Gewaltthema – „There is still heavy tourist traffic, and you will easily find yourself accosted by people in the streets selling goods and services“
